items.name: tokens
items.description: Candor's tokens without its colours: the --cd-* variables, Candor's own @theme entries and the motion utilities every item's classes assume. It sets nothing a shadcn project already defines (radius, sidebar, colour roles, type scale, base styles). Every item installs it. A Candor project imports styles/candor.css and needs nothing more; with plain shadcn and your own colours, import styles/candor-tokens.css once, after Tailwind.

breaking.change: The 2.2 motion tokens `--cd-pop-from` and `--cd-motion-shake`, kept through 2.x as the last fallback of their families, are no longer read, and `data-motion="expressive"` no longer sets their presets.
breaking.breaks: A brand file or the app's own CSS that sets `--cd-pop-from` or `--cd-motion-shake` stops having an effect.
breaking.migration: `--cd-pop-from` becomes `--cd-motion-pop-scale`, which applies from the expressive level only. `--cd-motion-shake` set a whole animation at every level and has no single replacement: set the refuse family's `--cd-motion-refuse-distance`, `-dur` and `-ease`, which move at the expressive level only.

breaking.change: The 2.2 animation utilities (`animate-shimmer`, `animate-pulse-dot`, `animate-rise-in`, `animate-caret`, `animate-collapse-down`, `animate-collapse-up`, `animate-pop-in`, `animate-pop-out`, `animate-tick-draw`, `animate-fill`, `animate-shake`, `animate-attention`, `animate-attention-wait`, `animate-nudge`) are removed, with the unprefixed keyframes only they ran (`pulse-dot`, `rise-in`, `caret`, `collapse-down`, `collapse-up`, `pop-in`, `pop-out`, `tick-draw`, `fill`, `shake`, `attention`). The `shimmer` keyframes stay: the `shimmer-text` utility runs them. Candor's own components use none of these utilities.
breaking.breaks: A class such as `animate-pop-in` in the app's own markup stops animating, and CSS that names one of the keyframes (`animation: pop-in …`) finds none.
breaking.migration: Use the motion families' utilities (`cd-pop`, `cd-reveal`, `cd-arrive`, `cd-refuse`, `cd-attention`, `cd-live-pulse` and the rest), which a brand file and `data-motion` reach; the Design page lists them. For `animate-shimmer`, use `shimmer-text` on text, or write the animation with the `shimmer` keyframes, which stay. The codemod renames `pulse-dot`, `rise-in`, `caret`, `pop-in`, `tick-draw`, `fill` and `attention` keyframes to `cd-pulse-dot`, `cd-rise`, `cd-caret`, `cd-pop`, `cd-draw`, `cd-grow` and `cd-ring` (same frames), and lists `pop-out`, `collapse-down`, `collapse-up` and `shake`, which need a direction or a size or distance variable besides the name.
